Set up. Summary:

- `cargo init` created a binary crate `windows_tool` (edition 2024).
- Added `winapi = "0.3.9"` with common feature modules (`winuser`, `handleapi`, `processthreadsapi`, `memoryapi`, `errhandlingapi`, `fileapi`, `synchapi`, `consoleapi`) for direct WinAPI bindings — enable more as you use them, since winapi gates everything behind feature flags.
- `src/main.rs` demonstrates a direct binding call (`MessageBoxW`) under `#[cfg(windows)]`, with a `#[cfg(not(windows))]` arm that fails the build with a clear `compile_error!` on non-Windows hosts instead of a confusing "no main function" error.
- `.cargo/config.toml` sets the default build target to `x86_64-pc-windows-gnu` so plain `cargo build`/`run`/`check` compile for Windows out of the box (verified working here since that target toolchain was already installed).
